Module sudoku
Package sudoku.model

Class Board

java.lang.Object
sudoku.model.Board
public class Board extends Object
The 6x6 Sudoku board. It stores the number of each cell and which cells are fixed (the initial clues that the player cannot change). The board is split into 6 blocks of 2 rows by 3 columns. Rows and columns start at 0.
